text: Blessed are those who observe justice [by honoring God's precepts], Who practice righteousness at all times.
That I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, That I may rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, That I may glory with Your inheritance.
Then Israel believed in [the validity of] His words; They sang His praise.
So He gave them their request, But sent a wasting disease among them.
And a fire broke out in their company; The flame consumed the wicked.
And that He would cast out their descendants among the nations And scatter them in the lands [of the earth].
And that was credited to him for righteousness, To all generations forever.
Because they were rebellious against His Spirit, Moses spoke recklessly with his lips.
In this way they became unclean in their practices; They played the prostitute in their own deeds [by giving their worship, which belongs to God alone, to other "gods"].
Many times He rescued them; But they were rebellious in their counsel, And sank down in their wickedness.
He also made them objects of compassion Among those who had carried them away captive.
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, From everlasting even to everlasting. And let all the people say, "Amen." Praise the LORD! (Hallelujah!)
